title: Downtown Gilbert Food Tour -Alcohol Package Included
requirements: All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Operates in all weather conditions, please dress appropriately
Availability for tours cannot be checked without making a booking. Credit cards will only be charged upon confirmation of tour availability
Children must be 11 years or older ( no strollers, no babies)
Vegetarian option is available, please advise at time of booking if required
We cannot accommodate for Gluten -free, dairy- free, vegan diet, or other food restrictions
No substitutions made for cocktail samples
Not recommended for people that have difficulty with walking.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
One-of-a-Kind Food Tasting — On our 3-hour tour of Downtown Gilbert we invite you to taste the best of the old and the new. Visit the restaurants that have become beloved Gilbert institutions as well as the new popular restaurants that have turned into instant local hot spots. 
 • On this tour, you will enjoy delicious craft pizza, a freshly baked dessert, decadent barbecue, authentic Mexican street tacos and house-made taffy, paired with a variety of cocktails. (We also take you down into a hidden speakeasy with a special code word!)

Tours last approximately three hours

Tours run rain or shine 
 • Restaurants 

Joe's Real BBQ

Liberty Market

Clever Koi 

Topo

Gelato Cimmino

 • Includes Food at (5) different spots and a knowledgeable, friendly tour guide
